newsitem.title: UK: UU UP, MARKET LOOKS BEYOND CHAIRMAN FURORE.
newsitem.headline: UU UP, MARKET LOOKS BEYOND CHAIRMAN FURORE.

text.p: Shares in United Utilities Plc defied a sharply weaker market to trade 4-1/2p higher at 705-1/2p as investors looked beyond the current furore over executive chairman Sir Desmond Pitcher's future, analysts said.
Boardroom dissent and Pitcher's surprise sacking of chief executive Brian Staples last month has depressed the shares recently but analysts are now putting a price target of 750-760p on the stock.

"At the end of the day there's a good underlying business there with massive revenue flows from water and electricity and we are not talking about a key personality," said Yamaichi analyst, Nigel Hawkins.
